name: godot_hosts
description: List the Godot editors offered to OpenCode on this computer (an editor whose project has OpenCode Link offers it when it starts, labelled with the project and the open scene): label, Godot version, and whether this conversation or another one is attached to each (attached_to: the one this conversation acts on), with the installed part's state. attach: attach one (its offerID) to this conversation, which asks permission; detach: release this conversation's editor. With one editor offered that no conversation uses, the first Godot tool call attaches it.
